title: Historical Source Adjudication
description: Adjudicate historical/archive claims: locate primary archival sources, verify temporal scope, test alternative mechanistic or interpretive accounts, and confirm source independence before a qualified claim.

common_failure_modes.note: Multiple 'independent' historical accounts derive from one chronicle.
Single interpretive account assumed without alternatives.
Claimed temporal scope incompatible with sourced period.

escalation_conditions.when: candidate claim ceiling would exceed QUALIFIED
temporal scope inconsistent with sourced record

stop_criteria.condition: primary sources located, alternatives tested, temporal scope verified, obligations satisfied
stop_criteria.note: Qualified ceiling only after external review.

stop_criteria.condition: no primary source located after search
